text: Resident Julie Porter challenged Barry Lyga's Boy Toy, alleging that it had been acquired with public funds in violation of the law. Superintendent William Harbron denied her removal request, and a staff committee recommended keeping the book. The Dover School Board then unanimously voted to keep Boy Toy at the Alumni Drive school after taxpayer Julie Porter requested reconsideration.
